title: Grilled Nectarine Toast
description: A sweet and savory breakfast or brunch recipe featuring grilled nectarines and crispy toast. Perfect for warm weather.
instructions: Grill the nectarine slices for 2-3 minutes per side, until slightly charred.
Meanwhile, toast the Luscious Toast until crispy.
Spread a small amount of Turkish on each slice of toast.
Top each slice with a grilled nectarine wedge.
